definitions.gloss: official use; official business; public use
definitions.explanation: Use for governmental, public, or company business rather than private purposes. Often contrasts with {私用|しよう} (personal use).

examples.japanese: {公用|こうよう}で{出張|しゅっちょう}する。
この{車|くるま}は{公用|こうよう}なので、{私用|しよう}では{使|つか}えない。
examples.english: This car is for official use, so it can't be used privately.

examples.japanese: スイスでは{複数|ふくすう}の{言語|げんご}が{公用語|こうようご}として{認|みと}められている。
examples.english: In Switzerland, several languages are recognized as official languages.

notes:
Composed of {公|こう} (public, official) + {用|よう} (use). Marks something as being for public or official business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公用|こうよう}で: on official business
- {公用車|こうようしゃ}: an official / government car
- {公用語|こうようご}: official language

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {私用|しよう}: personal / private use
